80
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, April 24, 2012/Vaisakha 4, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and Forests; Finance;
Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Rural Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Malaria deaths in the country
*261. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 717 given
in the Rajya Sabha on 20 March, 2012 and
state:
(a) whether 1018 deaths occurred due
to malaria in the countryin 2010;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has received
the report from the National V ector Borne
Disease Control Programme Committee on
malaria deaths;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
Committee estimated an average of more
than 40,000 deaths due to malaria; and
(e) if so, whether the Ministry would
consider revising its official figures based
on this?
Primary Co-operative Agriculture
Land Development Banks
*262. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of Primary
Co-operative Agriculture Land
Development Banks (PCALDBs) are
providing loans for long terms to the
farmers for purchasing tractor etc.;
(b) if so, the number of such banks and
the amount of loan sanctioned by them
during the last three years;
(c) whether the nationalized banks are
also sanctioning the loan, similar to the
loans sanctioned by these banks;
(d) if so, whether the existence of
PCALDBs is in danger; and
(e) the details of steps Government is
taking to stop the closure of these banks?
Mini ATMs in villages
*263. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Unique
Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
has recommended to set up 10 lakh Mini-
ATMs in villages;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how it will be connected with the
social schemes?

81
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Fluctuations in international prices of
raw petroleum products
†*264. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of fluctuations in prices
of raw petroleum products per barrel in
international market during the last three
years;
(b) whether any study has been
conducted on adverse effects on other
articles due to increase in prices of
petroleum products; and
(c) the details of profit and loss shown
in the annual reports of different petroleum
companies during the last three years?
Environmental clearance to POSCO
Project
†*265. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Green Tribunal (NGT) has cancelled the
environmental clearance earlier accorded
to Odisha based POSCO Steel Project;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons advanced for the
cancellation of the clearance given earlier?
Purchase of LNG at spot prices
*266. SHRI MANI SHANKAR
AIYAR: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the spot
prices of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) are
neither linked to crude oil prices any longer
nor determined by the Henry Hub Pricing
mechanism;
(b) whether the purchase of spot LNG
by developed economies has declined in
the light of large shale gas discoveries in
North America and the European Union;
and
(c) if so, whether Indian Oil PSUs will
be encouraged to purchase LNG at spot
prices?
Laws for curbing fraud by financial
companies
†*267. DR. C.P. THAKUR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of laws enacted by
Government in order to curb those
companies which defalcate the money of
common people in the name of profitable
investment;
(b) whether any action has been taken
by Government to punish the persons
responsible for the scams in companies like
Speakasia, Laqena Well World Marketing
etc.; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Purification of major rivers in the
country
†*268. SHRI THAW AR CHAND
GEHLOT: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the action plan for the
purification of the major rivers of the
country namely, Ganga, Yamuna, Krishna,
Kaveri, Narmada, Chambal, Godavari, etc.;
(b) the funds sanctioned for
implementation of the action plan; and
(c) the details of the status of
implementation of the action plan, so
far?

82
Neo-natal deaths
*269. SHRI RAJIV PRATAP RUDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
high rates of neo-natal deaths in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has identified
the reasons behind the prevalence of high
neo-natal death rates in some States;
(d) whether any financial assistance is
being extended to such States in this regard;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Adoption of new drug pricing policy
*270. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has rejected the recommendations of the
Department of Pharmaceuticals (DoP) on
pricing of essential drugs and decided to
adopt a new pricing policy; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Impact of increasing interest rates on
NPAs
*271. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether higher interest outgo due
to increasing interest rates has led to rise
in Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) in banks;
(b) if so, the details thereof in respect
of public sector banks;
(c) whether the Reserve Bank of India
(RBI) is considering any relief in the
guidelines regarding restructuring of
accounts and classification of NPAs in view
of global meltdown and recession in India;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Financial irregularities in PSEs
*272. SHRI N. K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEA VY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
financial irregularities in the Public Sector
Enterprises (PSEs);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for failure in checking
these irregularities;
(d) the action Government proposes to
take on the basis of the Comptroller and
Auditor General’s Report in terms of
financial irregularities in PSEs; and
(e) the total loss accrued to Government
exchequer during the last three years due
to these financial irregularities in PSEs?
Investment of subsidiary companies in
DEV AS
*273. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
had approved the investment by subsidiary
companies of DEV AS multimedia into it
and also allowed the change in the structure
of DEVAS;
(b) the authority which authorised these
investments and the reasons therefor;
(c) whether a subsidiary is allowed to
invest in parent company;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor and how
these investments were allowed;
(e) the action taken against the guilty
in this regard;

83
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(f) whether an enquiry by JPC or CBI
will be conducted into the whole DEVAS
issue; and
(g) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Agricultural loan to small and
marginal farmers
†*274. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Farmers Commission had recommended to
provide loan to the farmers at the interest
rate of four per cent;
(b) whether the Department-related
Standing Committee on Agriculture had
recommended to increase the amount of
crop loan from ` 3 lakh to ` 5 lakh;
(c) whether due to availability of very
few bank branches in the villages,
especially in North-Eastern States, it is very
difficult for the marginal farmers to avail
loans; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to ensure that small and
marginal farmers can get the loan in time?
Cashless treatment facility at health
centres
275. SHRI S. THANGA VELU: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to modernise all health centres
in the country to provide cashless
treatment;
(b) if so, whether this proposal is to
strengthen facilities at the primary health
centres, community health centres and
district hospitals so as to provide a
minimum package of care to all citizens
through provision of cashless and hassle-
free outpatient and inpatient diagnostic care
and supply of essential medicines; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
funds allocated for this purpose?
Mutli-crore forestry scam in Haryana
*276. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CBI has
opined that the multi-crore forestry scam
in Haryana exposed by a whistleblower is
a fit case for it to investigate independently;
(b) whether it is also a fact that many
officials have attempted to scuttle the
investigation; and
(c) if so, by when both the Union and
State Governments would give  their nod
for independent investigation?
Withdrawal of power from States for
CRZ clearance
*277. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that power has
been withdrawn from the State Authorities
for granting Coastal Regulation Zone
(CRZ) clearance for those projects which
do not require clearance under the
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
Notification, 2006;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government would
delegate this power back to the State
Governments?

84
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 18th April, 2012 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 29, 1934 (Saka)
Availability and maintenance of
dialysis machines in Government
hospitals
*278. SHRI KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether kidney patients requiring
frequent dialysis are facing problems due
to non-availability or inadequate
maintenance of dialysis machines in
Government hospitals;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
install more dialysis machines in these
hospitals for the benefit of poor patients,
particularly in Punjab;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the monitoring mechanism put in
place to ensure availability and proper
maintenance of these machines?
Objections to wage revision under
MGNREGS
*279. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE : Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has recently
revised the wages under the Mahatma
Gandhi National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether all the States have agreed
to the wage revision formula of
Government under MGNREGS;
(d) if not, the names of the States which
have raised objections on the recent
revision of wages under MGNREGS; and
(e) the steps Government proposes to
take to address their objections?
Upgradation of cancer treatment
centres in Kerala
*280. DR. T.N. SEEMA : Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any proposal from the Regional Cancer
Centre, Thiruvananthapuram and Malabar
Cancer Centre, Thalassery for Central
assistance to upgrade their facilities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the status of approval of these
proposals; and
(d) by when the final approval to these
proposals is expected to be given?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Drinking Water and Sanitation : —
Environment and Forests : 265, 268, 276, 277,
Finance : 262, 263, 267, 271, 273, 274,
Health and Family Welfare : 261, 269, 270, 275, 278, 280,
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises : 272,
Petroleum and Natural Gas : 264, 266,
Rural Development : 279.
85
GMGIPMRND—71RS—17-04-2012.
